{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute conversion rates by channel and customer segment
conversion_by_segment_channel = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the weighted average conversion rate for each channel, using the segment distribution as weights
# First, get the segment distribution for each channel
segment_dist_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the weighted average conversion rate for each channel
weighted_conversion = (conversion_by_segment_channel * segment_dist_by_channel).sum(axis=1)

# Compute the difference in weighted conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference_weighted = weighted_conversion['email'] - weighted_conversion['paid_search']

# Print the results
print("Segment distribution by channel:")
print(segment_dist_by_channel)
print("\nWeighted conversion rates by channel:")
print(weighted_conversion)
print(f"\nDifference in weighted conversion rates (email - paid_search): {difference_weighted}")"}
